notes.title: The second update has arrived!
notes.content:
The second update has arrived!
Now: 
 Windows 32 is supported
 MacOs is supported
 Linux 32 and 64 versions are supported now
 The third level is changed a little
 There are more sounds for explosions and NPC's deaths
 Slimes are no longer silent
 Some new sounds for the first level
 Screen shakes when the player is killed or the player has killed somebody
 Some bugs were fixed
 Some bugs are added

A Top-Down Job: Blood Gain will be on sale from 28 May 2019 11:00pm until 7 June 2019 11:00pm. Hurry to buy the game during this period! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/934470/A_TopDown_Job_Blood_Gain/
I hope to see any bugreports from players.
Have a good day.
